tools.name: list_library_books
tools.description: List books from the EngineerPro 118-book engineering library slice with lane tags and profile availability.

tools.name: get_library_book
tools.description: Return one library row plus its structured profile (thesis, model, instrument summary) when a sidecar exists.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Substring search across title, author, lane tags, and classifier tags.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Catalog of interactive SE tools with REST path hints.

tools.name: get_concept
tools.description: Return one engineering concept's definition, a cited ≤60-word answer, and the books it's grounded in (EP-217, derived from bicycle-guide's canonical guide bodies).

tools.name: compare_tradeoff
tools.description: Return one named engineering tension's opposing camps, a cited answer, and the books it's grounded in (EP-217).

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Substring search across the SE tools catalog and its guide bindings (EP-219: bound step, construct, tension).

tools.name: get_guide_section
tools.description: Return the free overview excerpt for a flagship engineering guide plus the apex take-away link and cited source books (EP-204). Optionally supply a section name to get a specific section summary and its grounding citations.
